title: Add Cookie privacy notice for CELA compliance
body:
Having submitted this site and details on the embedded 3rd cookies to [the cookie portal](aka.ms/cookieportal), this site will need a Cookie disclaimer message to comply with EU regulations.

* Sharepoint: [Cookie Compliance Steps](https://microsoft.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/teams/Azure_Compliance/Cookies/_layouts/15/WopiFrame.aspx?sourcedoc=%7BCCF4626F-5CE6-49E5-B4EA-9FA8435A324E%7D&file=Cookie%20Compliance%20-%20Step%20by%20step%20guidance.xlsx&action=default&IsList=1&ListId=%7B472906AB-F6D9-4943-8B9D-5133B9CB2AAD%7D&ListItemId=1)
* Sharepoint: [Cookie Wiki](https://microsoft.sharepoint.com/teams/Azure_Compliance/Cookies/Cookies/Home.aspx)
* MS [Cookie Portal](https://cookiecomplianceportal.azurewebsites.net/Home/GetStarted#/)
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
